question: What is in this bar, in order? Anything unusual (two voices, a triplet, a grace note, a pickup)?
verbatim: How one has a quarter note followed by an eighth note tied to a dotted eighth note followed by 3 sixteenth notes. There's a tie going to the first quarter note from the previous bar and a slur from the previous bar going all the way to the last note of the bar. Tile 2 has an eighth note rest and 3/8 notes with a P dynamic underneath it. Tile 3 is a whole note rest. Tile 4 is a quarter note followed by an eighth note with a natural sign in front of it, followed by a quarter and then another eighth note. There are a lot of other things in the box, including an MF, a hairpin crescendo, and the 2/8 note heads, as well as the natural, accidental, are outside of the orange box, as well as an A2 and a slur. That one seems pretty messy. That's 4. 5. Tile 5 has only an F clef, nothing else in it. I don't see any orange box, actually. Tile 6 is a quarter note followed by a quarter note rest with an F dynamic marking underneath it that belongs to it. It's half cut by the orange box and then an SF that belongs to the staff above it that's snuck into the orange box. That's through 6. File7 has two half notes a second apart, both with ties. Eight has an F clef. Three key accidental flats. And a whole rest . Nine has a dotted half with a tremolo slash. Ten has two quarters on a single stem, followed by a quarter rest. 'On the top of those two quarter notes has a sharp in front of it.
